description: Veronese — Colore: Raspberry & silvery gold Codice: 5638 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Classic Scala: Medium Altezza: 140.5 cm Rapporto: 20 cm × 26 cm Toni: Pink In a motif of pomegranates, pinecones, and pineapples, VERONESE celebrates the wealth, knowledge, and beauty of the Late Renaissance in an ode to the Venetian painter of the same name.
